Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: master brand illustration, candidate A, for Planet Green's 'The Act of Giving Back'. Create one exceptional commissioned-quality editorial illustration, no text or branding within artwork. The supplied plant engraving is a STYLE AND COLOUR REFERENCE ONLY: retain its delicate botanical engraving craftsmanship and green ink tonal depth, do not copy the plant layout.
Compose five subjects as ONE balanced, almost circular but asymmetrical open narrative, with generous clear negative space in the centre. A majestic single broad botanical leaf canopy with believable intricate veins curls across the upper left. Soft pale green-white diffused illumination at the upper right implies understanding without a sun icon or golden orb. A translucent, finely textured water-and-air-like organic fold descends along the right side and bends toward the base, connecting the leaf to humanity's returning care, never an arrow or circular stroke. Along the bottom, one graceful anatomically believable human hand is viewed palm-up in three-quarter side view, softly cupped, five anatomically correct digits naturally overlapping in perspective. The wrist enters from lower left and fingers support a tiny two-leaf seedling at lower centre. The seedling grows from a very small living soil patch held by the hand. Make the hand green-tinted engraved natural illustration, not a flat icon, literal photo or plastic object. Beautifully restrained layered material transitions, fine intaglio botanical linework and soft green wash, natural shadows and tactile surface. Nature gives, humanity recognises, humanity restores: subtly visible in one continuous composition.
Palette: Forest #156B37, living green #50AD47, leaf #B5D5A1, Mist #E8F0E1 with only subtle tonal shading and neutral highlights. No pink, purple, blue, orange or dominant yellow. Indian sensibility comes from interdependence and respectful care, no religious motifs. Premium contemporary, minimal silhouette with rich detail, NOT an eco logo or generic clip art. Leave generous transparent margin and real transparent centre/negative space; do not add a white disc or rectangle. Need true alpha background so artwork works on white and forest-green backgrounds. High-resolution square composition. No words, logos, lettering, watermarks, lotus, mandala, religious symbols, recycling graphics, border ring, circular arrow, stock icon, extra hands, extra fingers, particles, dramatic glow or decorative flourishes.
